description: Self-upgrade-via-clone against an OIDC-enabled Hub. Reuses the existing orchestrator flow (clone temp deployer → upgrade source → new CT replaces old Hub) but the precondition is that the Hub already has OIDC+HTTPS active (set up by self-reconfigure-enable-https-oidc). Validates that (1) the bearer-authenticated runner can still pull the diagnose bundle from the new CT, (2) the clone stays OIDC-stripped during its lifetime (intentional — Hub-to-Clone HTTP is internal/trusted), (3) OIDC env vars (OIDC_ENABLED, OIDC_ISSUER_URL, ...) ride through the /config-volume migration into the new CT.
